label: Quiet product system
summary: Calm implementation-first product UI kit for SaaS, dashboards, docs, and admin surfaces where clarity matters more than spectacle.
audience: SaaS app, dashboard, internal tool, docs product, implementation-ready UI
mood: Quiet, exact, spacious, accessible, restrained, high-trust.

frame.objective: Turn the sketch into a polished product screen with clear states, strong hierarchy, and implementation-ready components.
frame.layout: Map rough boxes into real nav, cards, forms, tables, empty states, and action regions without adding decorative clutter.
frame.motion: Use only meaningful state transitions for loading, filtering, navigation, hover, and focus.
frame.assets: Prefer iconography, data examples, avatars, and product screenshots only when they clarify the workflow.
frame.mobile: Convert dense layouts into prioritized cards, sticky actions, and progressive disclosure.
